documents.title: Select an activity, Quick actions and Activity actions
documents.content: The toolbar above the activity form provides New activity, Select an activity, Quick actions, and Activity actions. New activity resets the form. Select an activity searches open activities by subject, notes, linked client, or linked project; enable Show completed activities to include completed records. Quick actions mirrors the signed-in user's Favorite Actions from My Shortcuts in the same order, and Manage favorites opens the existing customization screen. Activity actions is available after an existing activity is selected and provides timer controls, Log actual time, Mark complete or Reopen, View agenda, Go to project workspace when linked, and Delete. Switching records or following an internal Quick action asks before discarding unsaved edits.

documents.title: Action, Project, Note, Subject and Notes
documents.content: Open Activity Manager at /event-manager. Choose Action, Project, or Note. Action covers both things to do and appointments. A new Action is stored as a task; an older appointment still appears under Action and keeps its stored appointment type. Enter the required Subject. Notes are optional and replace the former Details label. Client, Project, and Assign to are optional searchable dropdowns. Selecting Project tints its picker; selecting Note tints the Notes background while retaining the standard border.

documents.title: How Next free slot chooses a time
documents.content: For a new activity opened directly in Activity Manager, the When band defaults to Next free slot. Ogeemo searches the selected assignee's scheduled, unfinished, timed events for the first 30-minute gap inside 9:00 AM–5:00 PM. It searches today from the next five-minute boundary, then subsequent weekdays. Today is still allowed on a weekend. Completed, all-day, unscheduled, and untimed items do not block a slot. The suggestion follows an assignee change until the user edits the date or time. If no suitable time exists within 14 days, no slot is suggested.

documents.title: When choices and schedule preservation
documents.content: The When band under Subject has three choices: Next free slot, Pick a time, and No set time. Next free slot supplies a calendar-based suggestion. Pick a time keeps scheduling enabled and lets the user choose Start, End, or All-day. No set time saves the activity unscheduled. Editing a suggested date or time changes the band to Pick a time so later refreshes do not overwrite the user's choice. Opening an existing event or arriving through a calendar handoff preserves that event's own schedule instead of applying the new-activity suggestion.

documents.title: Save, Save & New, Cancel and Delete
documents.content: Save, Save & New, and Cancel are at the top of Activity Manager below the selection toolbar. Save stores the activity and returns to the previous page. Save & New stores it, refreshes the calendar used for availability, resets the form, and suggests another free slot so the just-used time is not reused. Cancel asks before discarding unsaved edits, then returns to the previous page. A Subject is required before Save or Save & New. Delete Activity is available in Activity actions and at the bottom when editing an existing activity; deletion returns Activity Manager to a clean New activity state.

documents.title: Time sessions and billing
documents.content: The Time Sessions card records actual work on an activity. Start a session to run the timer; pause, resume, or log the session as needed. Activity actions also provides Log actual time for a manual hours-and-minutes session ending now, and the Calendar's Log Actual Time link opens the same dialog for the selected activity. Actual sessions take precedence over the planned schedule span for recorded duration. Mark as billable controls whether the activity can be included on an invoice and reveals the hourly rate. Status can be To Do, In Progress, or Done. Scheduled time by itself is planning information, not automatically billable work.
